translation.name: Di Nyoo Testiment eena Bileez Kriol
translation.englishName: New Testament in Belize Kriol English (BH:bzj:Belize Kriol English)

book.name: REVILAYSHAN
book.title: DI REVILAYSHAN Weh Jeezas Krais Gi Jan

content: Den op eena hevn Ah si wahn nada sain, wahn impoatant sain weh Ah kudn bileev. Sebm aynjel mi deh ahn dehn kohn fi bring sebm bad tingz, terabl tingz, pahn di peepl a di werl. Dehn tingz wahn mek peepl sofa bad. Dehndeh da di laas ting dehn weh Gaad wahn sen fi shoa ih raat.

Den Ah si sohnting weh luk laik wahn see weh mek owta glaas ahn weh miks op wid faiya weh di bon eensaida it. Ahn di stan op kloas tu di see da mi dehn peepl weh mi win di vikchri oava di bees ahn oava ih stachu ahn oava di nomba a di naym a di bees. Ahn dehn peepl mi-di hoal wahn haap weh Gaad mi gi dehn.
Dehn mi-di sing di sang weh Moaziz, Gaad servant, mi-di sing ahn di sang weh di Lam mi-di sing. Di sang seh,

content.text: aal weh yu du soh wandaful
dat ih lef wi wid wi mowt oapm.
Yoo da di King weh di rool fareva ahn eva.
yoo taak di chroot aal di taim.
Laad, yu noh ga nobadi weh noh wahn gi yu aana;
yu noh ga nobadi weh noh wahn prayz yu naym.
Yoo da di Wan chroo Gaad;
yu da di oanli wan weh hoali.
Aal di peepl a aal di nayshan dehn wahn kohn
dat yoo du weh rait fi chroo.”

content: Wen di peepl dehn don sing, Ah luk an Ah si Gaad templ eena hevn wid di plays oapm op wichpaa dehn kip di agreement weh Gaad mek wid ih peepl.

Den fahn owta deh kohn di sebm aynjel dehn weh di bring di sebm terabl chrobl dehn weh wahn mek peepl sofa. Dehn mi-di wayr kleen wait linin kloaz weh mi-di shain. Ahn wahn goal sash mi tai rong dehn ches.
Den wan a di foa livin kreecha dehn gi di sebm aynjel dehn sebm goal bowl. Aala di sebm bowl dehn mi ful op wid di wain weh di shoa di raat a Gaad. Hihn da di Wan weh alaiv now fareva ahn eva.
Gaad templ mi ful op wid smoak weh shoa Gaad powa ahn gloari. Ahn nobadi kuda mi goh eena da plays til di sebm terabl chrobl dehn weh di sebm aynjel dehn mi bring mi don hapm.
